fact: The Libyan News Agency reported on 4 February 2023 that the Ministry of Interior of the Government of National Unity was carrying out a digital transformation plan through its Information and Documentation Centre, under which the centre's teams installed the criminal-status certificate system at the Criminal Investigation Department branch in Al-Bayda for the eastern region, having already activated it in Benghazi, Sebha, Misrata, Tripoli, Zintan, Gharyan, Janzour and Zuwara; the system issues criminal-status certificates and is not a station reports system, and no finance is stated.
title: مركز المعلومات والتوثيق بوزارة الداخلية يباشر بتركيب نظام إصدار الحالة الجنائية والخدمات المصاحبة له للمنطقة الشرقية.
